## Body

F214 audit (corrected, review R256-001): guard outcomes over the same window as f-214-audit-before. That note's 'silent cold 785 / false cold 33' were cache-state view numbers, not guard outcomes. Commands: pij-rs fleet-report /Users/jordanknight --since 7d --threads 2 --out /tmp/f214/fr-all; just cache-ttl-audit /tmp/f214/fr-all (PR #256 head d94fa60).

### PAST_TTL replay (the prime's question for Jordan)

The same 9,402 decided deliveries, replayed under each value of the one switch. Each multiplier applies to every TTL (5 min, 30 min GPT, 1 h), but the hour stays the ceiling, so a 1 h seat refuses at 60 min under every option. Lifting the ceiling for 1 h seats would have allowed 19 more large deliveries at x1.5 (17 cold) and 30 at x2 (27 cold).

| policy (`cold_wake::PAST_TTL`) | large cold allowed (of which warned) | warm refused or warned (of which refused) | large refusals per week |
|---|---|---|---|
| before F214 | 265 (0) | 4 (4) | 124 |
| (a) refuse past the TTL: `RefuseAt { ttl_percent: 100 }` | 5 (0) | 56 (56) | 436 |
| **(b) warn TTL..60 min, refuse past 60: `Warn` (shipped)** | **265 (260)** | **56 (4)** | **124** |
| (c x1.5) refuse past 1.5 x TTL: `RefuseAt { ttl_percent: 150 }` | 59 (54) | 56 (31) | 357 |
| (c x2) refuse past 2 x TTL: `RefuseAt { ttl_percent: 200 }` | 103 (98) | 56 (14) | 296 |

Every option warns from the TTL to its refusal point, so a cold wake is never silent. The 56 warm sends are the same deliveries in each row; only how many are refused (rather than warned) changes. The 52 own-5-minute seats among them read the cache past their TTL (Copilot ones past Copilot's own recorded `cacheExpiresAt`, median 2.8 min past; no other call in between; next-call cache share median 0.997). Anthropic's 5-minute TTL is a minimum.

| copilot | claude-opus-5.5 | plain | 3,298 | 664 | 634 (211) → 425 (2) | 4 → 36 | 34 → 34 | 0 → 241 |
| claude | claude-opus-5-5 | anthropic | 3,333 | 129 | 62 (0) → 62 (0) | 0 → 0 | 67 → 67 | 0 → 0 |
| omp | claude-opus-5.5 | github-copilot | 995 | 179 | 172 (48) → 124 (0) | 0 → 20 | 7 → 7 | 0 → 68 |
| claude | claude-sonnet-5-5 | anthropic | 815 | 28 | 19 (0) → 19 (0) | 0 → 0 | 9 → 9 | 0 → 0 |

"Allowed in silence, yet cold" for small seats (under 400k) is by design: the guard never acts on them, because waking a small seat cold is cheap.
